item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find credible 2024 evidence that Hasina’s government genuinely tolerated peaceful protest, dissent, or independent community organization without retaliation. I also did not find reliable evidence of a durable non-retaliatory framework such as protected protest permits, noninterference with civil society, or restraint in surveillance and selective punishment. The best available counterevidence is just a post-crackdown internet restoration after protests were called off, which is too weak to offset the broader repression record.","evidence":[{"title":"Bangladesh blocks roads and internet, deploys army to curb protests","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 20, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/bangladesh-blocks-roads-and-internet-deploys-army-to-curb-protests/2183179/","summary":"Reuters reported soldiers in Dhaka, roadblocks, and suspension of internet/text services during the protest crackdown; this is direct evidence of retaliation against peaceful dissent and community mobilization.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.5","3B.6","3B.1","2B.4"]},{"title":"Bangladesh PM Hasina blames opposition for violence, curfew to remain","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 22, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/bangladesh-pm-hasina-blames-opposition-for-violence-curfew-to-remain-3528153","summary":"Hasina kept the curfew in place and blamed political opponents for the violence, which reads as selective punishment and a chilling signal to dissenters rather than toleration of protest.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.3","3B.5","3B.6","2B.6"]},{"title":"Bangladesh’s crackdown on protesters left more than 170 dead, U.N. says","publisher":"United Nations / OHCHR","date":"July 26, 2024","url":"https://bangladesh.un.org/en/275065-bangladesh-t%C3%BCrk-decries-government-crackdown-urges-respect-international-human-rights","summary":"The UN said more than 170 people had been killed and warned that internet shutdowns increase impunity; this strongly indicates dissent was met with state violence and a climate of fear, not permitted as peaceful civic activity.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.1","3B.2","2B.4","2B.9"]},{"title":"Bangladesh security forces target unarmed students","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"July 22, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/22/bangladesh-security-forces-target-unarmed-students","summary":"HRW reported security forces targeting unarmed students alongside Awami League-affiliated activists; that is strong evidence that peaceful protest and organization were not protected from retaliation.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.1","3B.2","2B.4","2B.5"]},{"title":"Bangladesh prime minister Hasina resigns amid mass protests","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"August 6, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/06/bangladesh-prime-minister-hasina-resigns-amid-mass-protests","summary":"HRW described extrajudicial killings, enforced disappearances, and attacks on protesters during the crackdown; this is direct evidence of retaliation against dissent rather than tolerance of lawful protest.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.1","3B.2","2B.4","2B.9"]},{"title":"Bangladesh: repression, security force abuses discredit elections","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"January 11, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/bangladesh-repression-security-force-abuses-discredit-elections","summary":"HRW reported arrests for criticism and widespread repression before the election, showing that dissent was already being chilled early in 2024, not protected.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.1","3B.2","2B.4","2B.5"]},{"title":"Bangladesh restores internet as students call off job-quota protests","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 29, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/bangladesh-restores-internet-as-students-call-off-jobquota-protests-3540555","summary":"Internet service was restored only after protesters called off the movement and conditions were said to be normalizing; this is the closest weak counterevidence, but it shows de-escalation after coercive disruption, not a willingness to permit protest without retaliation.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.5","3B.6"]},{"title":"Bangladesh will not let in any more Rohingya refugees - minister","publisher":"Reuters","date":"February 7, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/bangladesh-will-not-let-in-any-more-rohingya-refugees-minister/1958020/","summary":"Bangladesh framed refusal to admit additional Rohingya as a security necessity; this is a limited positive only in the sense of defensive border control, but it does not show openness to dissent or community organization inside Bangladesh.","question_ids":["3B.8","2B.3"]}]}
